title: Overview
summary: Introduces the report’s five functional areas: monetary policy, financial stability, supervision, payment systems, and consumer/community affairs.

title: Monetary Policy and Economic Developments
summary: Presents the Federal Reserve’s monetary‑policy actions, inflation and labor‑market trends, and the balance‑sheet runoff throughout 2023.

title: Recent Economic and Financial Developments
summary: Details 2023 inflation, GDP, labor‑market conditions, and financial‑market tightening that underpin the monetary‑policy discussion.

title: Financial Stability
summary: Describes the Board’s monitoring of systemic risks, vulnerability assessment, and coordination with domestic and international partners.

title: Monitoring Financial Vulnerabilities
summary: Outlines the four key vulnerability categories—asset valuations, borrowing, leverage, and funding risk—and how they are assessed each quarter.

title: Domestic and International Cooperation and Coordination
summary: Summarizes collaboration with the FSOC, Treasury, and the Financial Stability Board on systemic‑risk issues, climate risk, and digital assets.

title: Supervision and Regulation
summary: Explains the Fed’s supervisory mandate, covering banks, holding companies, savings‑loan entities, and financial‑market utilities.

title: Supervised and Regulated Institutions
summary: Provides a snapshot of the composition of the Fed’s supervisory universe, including state member banks, bank holding companies, and other entities.

title: Supervisory Developments
summary: Highlights post‑SVB actions, enhanced monitoring, and priority areas such as risk‑management, cyber resilience, and third‑party oversight.

title: Specialized Examinations
summary: Covers focused examinations in stress testing, fiduciary activities, securities dealing, and cybersecurity performed during 2023.

title: Enforcement Actions
summary: Details of formal and informal enforcement actions taken by the Board and Reserve Banks, including civil money penalties and corrective directives.

title: Financial Disclosures by State Member Banks
summary: Description of the reporting requirements for state member banks under Regulation H and the Securities Exchange Act.

title: Internal Appeals of Material Supervisory Determinations
summary: Explanation of the two‑level appeals process for material supervisory determinations, including panel reviews and final decisions.

title: Assessments for Supervision and Regulation
summary: Summary of assessments collected from large banking entities and transferred to the U.S. Treasury.

title: Training and Technical Assistance
summary: Programs providing training to foreign supervisors and minority‑owned depository institutions, including seminars and collaborations with international bodies.

title: Efforts to Support Minority‑Owned Depository Institutions
summary: Activities of the Partnership for Progress program, outreach events, and resources aimed at strengthening minority depository institutions.

title: International Engagement
summary: Participation in the Financial Stability Board, Basel Committee, CPMI, and IAIS, highlighting policy work and published guidance.

title: Shared National Credit Program
summary: Description of the interagency review of large, complex shared credit exposures.

title: Bank Secrecy Act and Anti‑Money‑Laundering Compliance
summary: Overview of BSA/AML examination activities, updates to the examination manual, and international sanctions coordination.

title: Regulatory Reports
summary: Information on reporting forms required from holding companies, foreign banks, and FFIEC uniform reports, including recent revisions.

title: Regulatory Developments (Rulemakings and Guidance)
summary: Chronology of 2023 rulemakings, policy statements, and guidance issued by the Board on topics such as crypto‑asset risks, liquidity, and capital requirements.

title: Payment System and Reserve Bank Oversight
summary: Summary of the Federal Reserve’s role in maintaining the U.S. payment and settlement system and overseeing Reserve Bank operations, including recent oversight initiatives.

title: Payment Services to Depository and Other Institutions
summary: Description of commercial check collection, ACH, Fedwire funds, national settlement, and the newly launched FedNow instant‑payment service.

title: Priced Services Cost Recovery
summary: Data on the recovery of direct and imputed costs for priced services, showing full cost recovery in 2023.

title: FedNow Service
summary: Introduction of the FedNow instant‑payment service, early adoption statistics and expected growth.

title: Fedwire Funds and National Settlement Services
summary: Performance of Fedwire funds transfers and the National Settlement Service, including transaction volumes and value.

title: Fedwire Securities Service
summary: Operations of the securities settlement system, cost recovery, and increase in Treasury‑security transfers.

title: FedLine Solutions
summary: Overview of electronic connectivity options for depository institutions and recent product changes.

title: Intraday Credit (Daylight Overdrafts)
summary: Explanation of the Federal Reserve’s intraday credit policy and low usage levels in 2023.

title: Currency and Coin
summary: Distribution of Federal Reserve notes and coins, banknote development initiatives, and currency education outreach.

title: Fiscal Agency and Government Depository Services
summary: Reserve Banks’ role as fiscal agents for the Treasury, including payment, financing, securities, and accounting services.

title: Payment System Research and Regulation
summary: Research topics on payment innovations, digital assets, and the Board’s regulatory responsibilities for the payment system.

title: Oversight and Audits of Reserve Banks
summary: Describes the Board’s audit processes, internal‑control assessments (COSO), and KPMG’s combined and individual financial statement audits.

title: Financial Performance and SOMA Holdings
summary: Presents 2023 income, expenses, net earnings, and details on the System Open Market Account (SOMA) assets and lending programs.

title: Pro Forma Financial Statements for Priced Services
summary: Provides balance‑sheet and income‑statement pro forma data for the Federal Reserve’s priced services, including revenue, expenses, and imputed costs.

title: Consumer and Community Affairs
summary: Covers the Federal Reserve’s consumer‑protection, community‑development, and fair‑lending activities, research, and outreach in 2023.

title: Consumer Compliance Supervision and Enforcement
summary: Outlines supervision of consumer‑protection laws, CRA examinations, and enforcement actions such as fair‑lending and flood‑insurance compliance.

title: Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) Performance and Regulation
summary: Summarizes CRA examination results, the 2023 final rule to modernize CRA regulations, and related performance evaluations.

title: Mergers, Acquisitions, and Coordination with Other Agencies
summary: Describes the Board’s role in evaluating bank mergers, coordination with the CFPB, OCC, FDIC, and other regulators.

title: Outreach, Examiner Training, and Consumer Complaints
summary: Details public outreach programs, examiner training initiatives, and statistics on consumer complaints and inquiries in 2023.

title: Regulatory Updates and Index Adjustments
summary: Lists 2023 adjustments to thresholds for exempt consumer credit, small‑loan appraisal exemptions, and CRA asset‑size categories.

title: Research, Surveys, and Emerging Consumer Issues
summary: Highlights the SHED household survey results, Board research publications, and analysis of emerging consumer‑risk topics.

title: Appendixes
summary: Contains supplementary statistical tables, detailed financial schedules, and other reference material.

title: Federal Reserve System Organization
summary: Lists key officials, Board of Governors members, and division leadership for the Federal Reserve System in 2023.

title: Federal Open Market Committee
summary: Details the composition, members, and alternate members of the FOMC for 2023.

title: Officers
summary: Lists the senior officers of the Federal Reserve Board, including secretaries and general counsel.

title: Board of Governors Advisory Councils
summary: Describes the Federal Advisory Council, its purpose, membership structure, and meeting schedule.

title: Community Depository Institutions Advisory Council
summary: Outlines the council’s role advising on community depository institutions and lists its members.

title: Community Advisory Council
summary: Explains the council’s mandate to advise on consumer and community issues and provides member information.

title: Model Validation Council
summary: Introduces the council established to provide independent advice on stress‑test model assessment; notes no members met in 2023.

title: Reserve Bank and Branch Leadership
summary: Summarizes the leadership structure of Reserve Banks and their branches, including chairs, presidents and first vice presidents.

title: Leadership Conferences
summary: Provides an overview of the various leadership conferences convened by Reserve Bank leaders.

title: Conference of Chairs
summary: Lists the chairs and executive committee members of the Conference of Chairs for 2023.

title: Conference of Presidents
summary: Identifies the presidents, chair, vice‑chair and secretary of the Conference of Presidents for 2023.

title: Conference of First Vice Presidents
summary: Names the chair, vice‑chair, secretary and assistant secretary of the Conference of First Vice Presidents for 2023.

title: Minutes of Federal Open Market Committee Meetings
summary: Provides links and brief description of the eight regularly scheduled FOMC meeting minutes for 2023.

title: Federal Reserve System Audits
summary: Covers the audit framework for the Board and Reserve Banks, including OIG activities and external reviews.

title: Office of Inspector General Activities
summary: Describes the OIG’s audit, evaluation, investigation, and reporting functions for the Board and CFPB.

title: OIG Reports Issued in 2023
summary: Lists the 19 OIG reports released in 2023, noting public and non‑public documents.

title: Government Accountability Office Reviews
summary: Summarizes GAO audit projects related to the Federal Reserve System completed or ongoing in 2023.

title: Federal Reserve System Budgets
summary: Presents 2023 budget performance, 2024 budget outlook, and expense and staffing figures for the Board and Reserve Banks.

title: Trends in Expenses and Employment
summary: Analysis of expense growth drivers, employment changes, and investment priorities from 2014 to 2024.

title: 2024 Capital Budgets
summary: Presentation of the Board’s and Reserve Banks’ capital budgets for 2024, including single‑year and multiyear projects.

title: Board of Governors Budgets
summary: Description of the Board’s budget process, 2023 performance, and 2024 operating and capital budget details.

title: Reserve Bank Budgets
summary: Explanation of Reserve Bank budgeting procedures and tables summarizing 2023 expenses, employment, and 2024 budget projections.

title: Currency Budget
summary: Details of the currency production budget, including single‑cycle and multicycle projects, BEP costs, and related Board expenses.

title: Record of Policy Actions of the Board of Governors
summary: Comprehensive list of the Board’s 2023 policy actions, including rules, regulations, statements, and rate decisions.

title: Rules and Regulations
summary: Final rule adopting risk‑based capital requirements for large holding companies and related regulatory changes.

title: Regulation BB (Community Reinvestment)
summary: Final rule modernizing the Community Reinvestment Act implementation, with new evaluation framework and geographic scope.

title: Rules of Practice and Procedure
summary: Final rule updating procedural rules to recognize electronic communications and improve administrative hearings.

title: Policy Statements and Other Actions
summary: Key 2023 policy statements on credit loss allowances, commercial real‑estate loan accommodations, and Section 9(13) interpretation.

title: Systemic Risk Exception and Bank Term Funding Program
summary: Board actions authorizing the systemic‑risk exception for SVB/Signature resolutions and establishing the BTFP emergency lending facility.

title: Third‑Party Risk Management Guidance
summary: Final interagency guidance providing consistent supervisory expectations for managing third‑party relationships.

title: Interest on Reserves
summary: Series of Board decisions in 2023 raising the interest rate paid on reserve balances to support FOMC policy.

title: Discount Rates for Depository Institutions
summary: Board actions setting primary, secondary, and seasonal credit rates for 2023 and providing related voting records.

title: Government Performance and Results Act Overview
summary: Describes the Board’s voluntary compliance with GPRA, outlining its four‑year Strategic Plan, Annual Performance Plans, and Annual Performance Reports.

title: Litigation
summary: Summarizes pending and resolved lawsuits involving the Board of Governors in 2023, including case numbers, courts, and primary legal issues.

title: Statistical Tables
summary: Collection of detailed statistical tables on the Federal Reserve’s balance sheet, securities holdings, reserve requirements, banking assets, and regulatory margins.

title: Statistical Tables – Open Market Operations and Securities Holdings
summary: Tables G.1 and G.2 presenting monthly open‑market transaction data and annual holdings of U.S. Treasury and agency securities.

title: Statistical Tables – Reserve Requirements and Banking Offices
summary: Tables G.3 and G.4 showing reserve‑requirement percentages and counts of banking offices and banks affiliated with holding companies.

title: Statistical Tables – Historical Reserve Funds
summary: Tables G.5A and G.5B detailing year‑end and month‑end reserve fund components for depository institutions from 1984‑2023 and 1918‑1983.

title: Statistical Tables – Commercial Bank Assets and Liabilities
summary: Table G.6 summarizing principal assets, liabilities, and equity of insured commercial banks for June 30 2023 and 2022.

title: Statistical Tables – Margin Requirements
summary: Table G.7 listing initial margin requirements under Regulations T, U, and X with effective dates and percentages.

title: Statistical Tables – Federal Reserve Bank Condition Statements
summary: Table G.8A presenting the statement of condition for each Federal Reserve Bank, including assets, loans, securities, and other balance‑sheet items as of Dec 31 2023 and 2022.

title: Table G.8A – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank, 2023 and 2022
summary: Presents detailed assets, liabilities, and capital accounts for each Federal Reserve Bank for 2023 and 2022.

title: Table G.8B – Statement of condition of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31, 2023 and 2022
summary: Summarizes total Federal Reserve notes outstanding, collateral, and Treasury securities for the system.

title: Table G.9 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, by Bank, 2023
summary: Shows current income, net expenses, and comprehensive income for each Reserve Bank for 2023.

title: Table G.10 – Income and expenses of the Federal Reserve Banks, 1914–2023
summary: Historical series of assessments, net income, and other financial aggregates for all banks from 1914 to 2023.

title: Table G.11 – Operations in principal departments of the Federal Reserve Banks, 2020–2023
summary: Provides volume data on currency processing, checks, securities and funds transfers, and ACH transactions.

title: Table G.12 – Number and annual salaries of officers and employees of the Federal Reserve Banks, December 31, 2023
summary: Lists headcount and salary totals for presidents, other officers, and employees across all Reserve Banks.

title: Table G.13 – Acquisition costs and net book value of the premises of the Federal Reserve Banks and Branches, December 31, 2023
summary: Details real‑estate acquisition costs and net book values for each Reserve Bank and its branches.
